components.name: Chart container
components.description: A bordered container for a forecast chart and its controls.
components.css: .ds-chart{background:var(--paper,#fff);border:1px solid var(--border,#e1e6de);border-radius:10px;padding:23px 24px 15px;color:var(--ink,#253e32)}.ds-chart h2{margin:0;font:700 17px/1.4 Manrope,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-chart h2 span{font:400 12px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:#61715c;letter-spacing:0;margin-left:9px}.ds-chart p{font:400 10px/1.7 'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:#61715c;margin:5px 0}.ds-legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:25px;font:400 10px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:#61715c}.ds-legend span{width:18px;height:2px;background:var(--green,#2d7658)}

narrative.overview: Northline is a compact analyst workspace. Evergreen navigation frames a warm off-white work area. Charts and aligned numeric tables carry the evidence, with source context beside the values. The chosen identity is recorded in docs/DESIGN_DIRECTION.md with concept-seed reference seed:0c8db3b6dd8a642a.
keyCharacteristics: Evergreen shell and warm off-white workspace.
Manrope headings with DM Sans controls and tables.
Green forecasts, orange retrospective actuals, and visible missing-data gaps.
dos: Do keep forecast green and actual orange consistent across charts and legends.
Do show units and London time beside the values or controls they qualify.
Do retain keyboard focus, selected control states, null gaps, and textual status labels.
Do keep source explanations beside the evidence they describe.
donts: Don't connect missing observations or substitute a zero for a gap.
Don't enable retrospective actuals by default.
Don't add decorative map illustrations or a decorative grid to express the identity.
